fifth_rung_preflight.question: whether a fifth rung would settle this ladder's observed order (10.467, clamped, conclusive false), asked before spending the rung
fifth_rung_preflight.answer: no, and the reasons are properties of the ladder, not of its length

recipe_defect.finding: coarse and medium share ONE castellated recipe and differ only in background block density (23x42x14 vs 33x60x20); production is the only rung at (3 4). By the standard the B-52 recipe_audit already set in this corpus -- rungs that do not share a refinement recipe are not extrapolation-comparable and must not be mixed into one Richardson/GCI fit -- this ladder has NO same-recipe triple. p = 10.467 is fitted across a recipe change, so it is not a discretization order at all, and a fifth rung inherits that.

convergence_defect.finding: two of the three rungs never converged; they ran to the 180-iteration cap with no convergence statement

wall_treatment_defect.source: system/snappyHexMeshDict, line 'addLayers false;' in all three run dirs
wall_treatment_defect.finding: every rung of this ladder is layerless at chord Reynolds 1.00e6. That is the exact defect for which the PREVIOUS 4412 ladder was superseded on 2026-07-27 (superseded.reason: 'addLayers false at Re 1e6 (no boundary-layer cells at all)'). The replacement ladder carries it too.

generator_hypothesis_tested_and_rejected.hypothesis: that the pyHyp aspect-ratio finding (GENERATOR_FINDING_pyhyp_aspect_ratio.md: max cell aspect ratio worsening under refinement, 97.9 to 167.5, because the extrusion holds its smoothing fixed while doubling point density) explains the finer 4412 rung's mesh-gate failure
generator_hypothesis_tested_and_rejected.verdict: REJECTED on two independent grounds, both measured
generator_hypothesis_tested_and_rejected.wrong_generator: every NACA 4412 mesh in this corpus is built by blockMesh + surfaceFeatureExtract + snappyHexMesh via external_aero.build_case. pyHyp appears nowhere in any 4412 path.

wrong_direction.note: max aspect ratio IMPROVES monotonically under refinement here, the opposite of the pyHyp signature

what_actually_degrades.note: non-orthogonality worsens monotonically and crosses the lab's own 70 degree gate at the finest rung, and achieved layer coverage collapses from 94% to 58.3%. checkMesh itself still prints 'Mesh OK' -- the failure is against the lab's stricter gate, not OpenFOAM's.

cost_basis_correction.docket_assumed: the next rung roughly doubles the cell count
cost_basis_correction.note: the r=4 layerless rung already exists and is already solved (337,334 cells, Cd 0.01892) in this file's superseded block, so the first genuinely new rung is r=5 at roughly 830,000 to 970,000 cells, not the ~675,000 the cost basis assumed

ladder_a_quality_trend.note: quality appears to improve from coarse to medium and then degrade at production. That is not a refinement effect: coarse and medium differ only in background block density, so the one real castellated step in this ladder (medium to production) makes every metric worse.
